import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 10000010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int total_nodes, total_edges, c_param, d_param, k_param, total_cost = 0;
    static int s = 0, t, edge_idx = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN], to = new int[MAXN], nxt = new int[MAXN], capacity = new int[MAXN], weight = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN], flow_infinity = new int[MAXN], parent_edge = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] inq = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int w) {
        to[++edge_idx] = v; nxt[edge_idx] = head[u]; head[u] = edge_idx; capacity[edge_idx] = cap; weight[edge_idx] = w;
        to[++edge_idx] = u; nxt[edge_idx] = head[v]; head[v] = edge_idx; capacity[edge_idx] = 0; weight[edge_idx] = -w;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(flow_infinity, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inq, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        flow_infinity[s] = INF;
        inq[s] = true;
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inq[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] == 0 || dist[to[i]] <= dist[u] + weight[i]) continue;
                dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + weight[i];
                flow_infinity[to[i]] = Math.min(flow_infinity[u], capacity[i]);
                parent_edge[to[i]] = i;
                if (!inq[to[i]]) {
                    inq[to[i]] = true;
                    q.offer(to[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }

    static void augment() {
        int node = t;
        while (node != s) {
            int i = parent_edge[node];
            capacity[i] -= flow_infinity[t];
            capacity[i ^ 1] += flow_infinity[t];
            node = to[i ^ 1];
        }
        total_cost += flow_infinity[t] * dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        total_nodes = sc.nextInt();
        total_edges = sc.nextInt();
        c_param = sc.nextInt();
        d_param = sc.nextInt();
        k_param = sc.nextInt();

        t = (total_nodes + k_param - 1) * total_nodes + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k_param; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(s, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= total_edges; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= total_nodes + k_param; j++) {
                for (int h = 1; h <= k_param; h++) {
                    int u1 = x + (j - 1) * total_nodes;
                    int v1 = y + j * total_nodes;
                    int cost = d_param * h * 2 - d_param + c_param;
                    add_edge(u1, v1, 1, cost);
                    int u2 = y + (j - 1) * total_nodes;
                    int v2 = x + j * total_nodes;
                    add_edge(u2, v2, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < total_nodes + k_param; i++) {
            for (int j = 2; j <= total_nodes; j++) {
                int u = j + (i - 1) * total_nodes;
                int v = j + i * total_nodes;
                add_edge(u, v, INF, c_param);
            }
            int u = 1 + (i - 1) * total_nodes;
            int v = 1 + i * total_nodes;
            add_edge(u, v, INF, 0);
        }

        while (spfa()) {
            augment();
        }

        System.out.println(total_cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
